products.title: 2024 Spring Flower Subscription
products.body_html:
Introducing our exclusive Spring Flower Subscription, designed to brighten up your dark and dreary Pittsburgh winter. Say goodbye to the monotony of grey and cold days, and welcome the vibrant colors and fragrant blooms of spring into your home! 

Your gift to yourself or someone special will include:

6 weekly bouquets of specialty tulips, ranunculus, anemones, peonies, and a mix of other spring blooms. Varieties in each bouquet are dependent on weekly crop availability. 

Spring flowers bloom based on the weather, and that means we can't exactly predict your first subscription date, though it will be sometime in mid- late April.  We will let you know via email (in advance) which week we will start subscription bouquets.

Available pickup locations: Bloomfield, Highland Park, Lawrenceville, North Side, Sewickley, Allison Park. ** Please enter a pickup location in the notes section on the cart page **

Direct home delivery is also available for an additional $10/wk.

 We'll be in touch in March to coordinate pick-up or delivery for your 2024 Spring Flower subscription!

products.title: 2024 Tiny Seed Farm Summer CSA
products.body_html:
Each week, from the first week of June through the following 20 weeks, you'll receive a handpicked selection of vegetables that represent the very best of the season.  Are you ready to embark on a fresh and flavorful journey through the bountiful seasons with Tiny Seed Farm? Join us starting on the first week of June 2024 as we kick off our Summer Vegetable CSA program, running for 20 weeks!

From juicy, vine-ripened tomatoes to crisp cucumbers and everything in between, our CSA will keep your kitchen brimming with flavor.

We will also continue to offer our FARM GROWN CSA add-ons! You will have the option of adding on a Tiny Seed Fleurs bouquet from our fields and/or farm grown mushrooms!

​We are proud to be partnering with Driftwood Oven, Wild Rise Gluten Free Bakery and Goat Rodeo Farm and Dairy for optional bread, gluten free bread and cheese add-ons.

Our large share is ideal for a small family and our small share is perfect for a couple or some bffs. You can get all of your New Years resolutions in one fell swoop! Save on groceries, eat better, cook with loved ones and support local agriculture! Sounds pretty good to me!

Along with your weekly share of vegetables, we'll provide you with a selection of recipes and tips to help you make the most of your bounty. Whether you're a seasoned chef or a novice cook, you'll find plenty of inspiration to create delicious meals.

products.title: 2026 Flex CSA Share
products.body_html:
Flex CSA Share

Support the farm early in the season and enjoy customized options with prepaid farm credit. Use your credit towards weekly CSA shares, online store purchases, or at any of our farmers' markets.

Choose the Right Share for You:

  • $1000 Tiny Seed Ultimate Supporter Share: For our most dedicated supporters who want to make a meaningful impact while enjoying maximum flexibility and access to farm-fresh organic products.
  • $800 Friends and Family Weekly Equivalent: Perfect for families or veggie lovers who enjoy the full weekly CSA experience.
  • $600 Small CSA Share Equivalent: Ideal for individuals or smaller households cooking throughout the week.
  • $400 Friends and Family Bi-Weekly Equivalent: A great option for those who want the Friends and Family experience on a bi-weekly schedule.
  • $300 Small Bi-Weekly Equivalent: Perfect for those who want fresh veggies every other week.
  • $150: Perfect for light eaters who want to order every now and then

How It Works:

  • Pre-Populated Cart: For convenience, your cart will be automatically filled with a weekly or bi-weekly CSA share based on your subscription level. You’ll have the freedom to customize your cart, add extras, or empty it entirely.
  • Flexibility: Use your Flex CSA funds toward weekly CSA shares, online store purchases, or at any of our farmers’ markets. Add-ons can be purchased separately as desired.
  • Seasonal Commitment: Funds must be used by the end of the season and cannot carry over.

Why Choose Flex CSA?

  • Support Local Agriculture: Your early-season investment directly supports our farm’s growth and operations.
  • Customizable Experience: Pick and choose exactly what you want each week to suit your household’s needs.
  • Convenience Meets Flexibility: Enjoy the structure of a pre-populated CSA share with the option to make it your own every week or bi-weekly.

By purchasing a Flex Subscription, you agree to the conditions and responsibilities outlined in the FAQs section.

products.title: Bunched Greens--Escarole
products.body_html: This leafy bundle looks a lot like a hearty head of leaf lettuce at first glance.  It has slightly bitter, nutty flavor when cooked. It's usually eaten cooked--try it in your favorite chicken soup!  It's also a classic choice for beans and greens.  It's amazing cut into quarters and charred on a grill--this is the basis for a classic summer salad in my house!

products.title: Bunched Greens-Bok Choy
products.body_html: Also known as Chinese cabbage.  Bok Choy has a crisp, watery texture and a peppery, nutty flavor.  It's delicious cooked in a soup or stir fry.  Sliced thinly it makes a delicious substitute for cabbage in coleslaw.

products.title: Bunched Greens-Broccoli Raab
products.body_html: Broccoli Raab, aka Rapini, has a distinctive nutty, pungent, bitter taste.  It is a staple in Italian cuisine.  Sauté it in olive oil with garlic and red pepper flakes for a delicious, simple side dish.  Or pan fry with sliced sausage and plenty of garlic, and toss with pasta.  You can also use broccoli rabe as the greens in your favorite beans and greens recipe.

products.title: Bunched Greens-Collards
products.body_html:
The heartiest of all the greens, collards are absolutely delicious stewed low and slow!
My absolute favorite way to cook these is in a coconut curry broth!

products.title: Bunched Greens-Curly Kale
products.body_html: The classic, frilly, curly kale we all know and love.  Great sauteed, in soups, or--try making your own kale chips!

products.title: Bunched Greens-Dandelion Greens
products.body_html: This is my all time favorite choice of greens for a classic beans and greens meal!  Dandelion greens pack more of a bitter punch than some other varieties of greens... but to those of us who love them, we *really* love them!  They stand up well to other strong flavors--I always put something spice and/or something smoked in with them.  They also work well as a substitute for spinach in one of those classic wilted greens bacon dressing salads.

products.title: Bunched Greens-Dino Kale
products.body_html: Dinosaur kale, aka Lacinato kale, is a tender variety of kale.  It's great cooked (sauteed with a little bit of garlic, olive oil, and chili flakes; as the green in beans and greens), or raw used in salads.  This is my go-to variety of kale for an extra hearty Caesar salad!

products.title: Bunched Greens-Mustard Greens
products.body_html: Mustard greens are less bitter than kale or collard greens, and more peppery, like arugula.  You can braise them like you would any other cooking green.  Or make a delicious homemade batch of sarson ka saag (a staple in my house!).  They are also great pickled!  Mustard greens are Frankie's second favorite green, after turnip greens--in case you wanted to know!

products.title: Bunched Greens-Napa Cabbage
products.body_html: Another one of Ms. Seed's personal favorites!  Feel like making your own homemade kimchi?   It's also SO GOOD as the substitute for "regular" cabbage in all sorts of slaws and salads.

products.title: Bunched Greens-Swiss Chard
products.body_html: Swiss chard is great in pretty much any recipe where you'd use spinach.  Sauteed with garlic and lemon, cooked in a lentil soup.  If you're an adventurous cook, you can stuff the leaves like you would cabbage or grape leaves for a twist on a classic dish.  One time I even made spanakopita with it, because why not???
